name: Lily's Babylon

evidence.note: Pub's events page lists Legendary Murphys on Sat Oct 3, 6-10 PM, and weekly happy-hour bands.
Local listing for a party band at Lily's invites people to come dance the night away.
Ticket page for Lily's After Dark club night, Sat Oct 3 from 10 PM, 18+ to enter.

dancing.notes: Party bands play early evening, and promoters invite people to dance. Later on weekend nights it runs 'Lily's After Dark' club nights for ages 18 and up with a cover charge.

description: A large Irish-American pub and restaurant on Deer Park Avenue in Babylon Village, formerly called Lily Flanagan's. It has happy-hour bands on Fridays and Saturdays and turns into a late-night club.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). The 6 PM band and the 10 PM 18+ club night are different crowds. We did not find photos showing a dedicated dance floor.
